title: HAI_LANGUAGE: Hierarchical active inference for language, reading, and eye movements
description: MATLAB implementation of a hierarchical active inference model of language, reading, and eye movements. This software accompanies the article "Integrating large language models and active inference to understand eye movements in reading and dyslexia" published in Physics of Life Reviews.
